response.original_title: FAQ-How to get a room upgrade on Cunard cruise
response.overview: You can upgrade your room on a Cunard cruise +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) by paying the cash fare difference before departure, +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) placing a blind bid through the online upgrade program, or asking about leftover availability once you board. Call Cunard customer service directly +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) contact your travel agent to check open higher-category rooms and pay the exact price difference to lock in your new choice. You can upgrade your room on a Cunard cruise by using their official bidding system called MoveUp +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) or by calling customer service directly. Yes, +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) you can upgrade your room on a Cunard Cruise after booking, subject to cabin availability and fare rules. Contact Cunard directly +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or reach out to your travel agent to check availability and pay the exact price difference for a higher category.
